model: RandomForestClassifier (n_estimators=500, random_state=42) with median imputation of zero-as-missing values (glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin, bmi)
notes: Stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42). followup_score excluded as a likely post-outcome leak: including it raised test accuracy to 0.927 but it is not a pre-diagnosis measurement.
